title: GameWorkspaceChips
responsibility: Shows the status chips in the Game Views header: demo, the historical commit, read-only and unsaved changes.

inputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips.demo
inputs.description: Whether the game is an in-memory example; true shows a Demo chip.

inputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips.commit
inputs.description: The historical commit being shown; when given, a History chip names its short id. Defaults to undefined, which shows no history chip.

inputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips.readonly
inputs.description: Whether editing is disabled; true shows a Read-only chip unless a commit is shown.

inputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips.dirty
inputs.description: Whether there are edits not yet saved; true shows an Unsaved changes chip.

outputs.name: GameWorkspaceChips
outputs.description: The chips that apply, in order, rendered as inline pills; none when nothing applies. Catalog states: default shows Unsaved changes; demo shows Demo; readonly shows Read-only; with-commit shows History with its short id and suppresses Read-only.
